markdown-reader — Native Desktop Markdown Reader

0

markdown-reader is the "Instant Reader" for Markdown files. It is a lightweight tool that makes reading documentation easy. Instead of opening a big code editor, you can just double-click any .md file to see a clean version of it instantly. It includes a helpful sidebar to help you jump between sections, works completely offline, and automatically updates the view if the file is changed by someone else. It’s built for anyone who wants a quick, distraction-free way to read notes and documentation.

gpx

0

Git Profile eXchanger (gpx) is a powerful command-line interface tool designed to seamlessly manage and switch between multiple Git identities, functioning similarly to nvm but for Git Identities. It allows developers to instantly change their Git name, email, and SSH keys either globally or locally for specific repositories. Beyond identity switching, gpx automates complex setup workflows by handling GitHub OAuth authentication, generating and uploading SSH keys, and managing shell prompt indicators. Built with safety in mind, it utilizes atomic writes to modify configs, isolates keys in dedicated directories, and includes diagnostic utilities to ensure system health.
